segment.source: List only the elements that have a demo record in this site's Element Library storage folder; the picker search is limited to the same elements. Use it when a site offers a subset of a provider's elements: seed only those, then switch this on. Applies together with "Element Library hosts".

XLIFF file with this site's own words for its elements, e.g. "EXT:my_theme/Resources/Private/Language/Library/site.xlf". Units are keyed <cType>.title, <cType>.description, <cType>.short, <cType>.keywords ("primary || synonyms", terms separated by " | ") and <cType>.group. Each unit that exists replaces the provider's text in the editor's language (translations in de.<file>); a missing unit keeps it. Empty = the provider's texts.

Surface of the menus: header dropdowns and their flyouts, the home-page mega menu, the language and colour-scheme menus. The options of the create page on ui.shadcn.com. "Inverted" paints the menus in the preset's dark colours on a light page; "translucent" lets the page show through a blurred, 70% opaque surface. "From the preset" uses the value stored in the preset's create code; house presets use "Default".

Highlight of the hovered, focused and current menu entry. "Subtle" uses the theme's accent colour, "Bold" the primary colour. Applies to the menus only, not to the accent of content elements. "From the preset" uses the value stored in the preset's create code; house presets use "Subtle".
